scope_rule: one package owns one directory under reconstruction/staging; this package creates and edits nothing outside reconstruction/staging/pkg-editor-wave11

reinspection.method: grep of the seven virtual addresses over reconstruction/staging, reconstruction/metadata, reconstruction/integrated and reconstruction/knowledge, plus a per-address scan of knowledgegraph/research/source-reconstruction-manifest.json and a read-only Ghidra decompile plus disassembly pass against SporeApp.exe
reinspection.conclusion: all seven addresses are unclaimed. No staging package, no integrated batch and no manifest function record references any of them, so this package takes all seven without displacing another worker.
reinspection.ghidra_access: read-only; decompile_function, disassemble_function, disassemble_bytes, get_function_by_address, get_function_callers, get_function_callees, read_memory and one run_script_inline that wrote disassembly listings to /tmp/opencode/wave11. No rename, no comment, no type change and no save was issued.

excluded.decision: not reconstructed in this wave; no source, no declaration and no test exist for it
excluded.shape: 0x004c73f0..0x004ca425, 12336 bytes, 2444 instructions, 119 call sites, 67 distinct callees, a 0x1a58 alloca frame and a 0x8c byte record stride
defects_observed: the decompilation is unreliable at exactly the points this body needs: it types the descriptor open and probe arguments wrongly, it drops the argument that the assembly pushes, and it names an uninitialised stack slot as the receiver of the descriptor loop

at least four separate decompilation defects were found and corrected in the six bodies this package did reconstruct, which sets the confidence bar a transcription of this body has to clear before it can be claimed

the argument order of the descriptor dispatch at 0x004c8b16 could not be pinned: three consecutive pushes interleave ESP relative loads whose base shifts per pending push, and two readings of that site disagree on which of the three arguments is the tracker

the out parameter identity of the array property pair at 0x004c9731 and 0x004c9794 is unresolved: the count, the base and the stride locals sit within four bytes of each other and one of them is written by two different ports
the mode byte that the five aggregation ports read as the byte immediately before the iterator cannot be given a naturally aligned layout without changing the argument identity the ports observe
the frame is compiler aligned, so the local slot addresses the body depends on are not reproducible by construction and would have to be asserted rather than derived
excluded.unblock_condition: an assembly driven pass that pins, per call site, the pending push depth and the resulting argument order for the 0x004c8b16 descriptor triple, the 0x004c9731 and 0x004c9794 array property out parameters, and the five aggregation mode bytes; with those three groups fixed the remaining body is straight line field filling that the decompilation already describes accurately
excluded.risk_if_claimed_now: a plausible looking twelve kilobyte transcription whose descriptor and array property argument orders are wrong would silently corrupt every record the editor bakes, which is strictly worse than recording the gap
